headline: Bank Competition Heats Up, Deposit Interest Rates Rise to 6%
summary: Bank deposit rates in Indonesia have risen to about 6 percent from October 2026, while lending rates have held steady at 8.9 percent.
why: Deposit and lending rates set by banks shape household savings, credit costs and the transmission of central bank policy into the economy.
original_headline: Persaingan Bank Makin Panas, Bunga Deposito Naik Sentuh 6%
